title: McCasland and Monica Reza cases possibly connected

tellings.quote: For example, General Neil McCasslin's case seems eerily possibly connected to Monica Resza's.

plain: Michels says the case of a general named Neil McCasland seems "eerily possibly connected" to the case of a woman named Monica Reza. He says this himself, in an episode about why top American scientists are going missing, offering it as a possible link rather than something shown; if the cases are connected, the disappearances might not be isolated.
